assertions.assertion: The service rendered was a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of underlying sick sinus syndrome and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study was necessary to evaluate for arrhythmia burden and guide further management
The denial was based on the missing prior authorization (CO-197)
